en: The postcard features a historic European street scene with a prominent corner building labeled 'Wettin-Haus.' The building appears ornate, with multiple floors and decorative architectural details. There are shops and a restaurant on the ground floor. People are seen standing and walking, and a tram (streetcar) is visible on the right side, suggesting a lively urban area. The text 'Kötzschenbroda' and 'Endstation d. Strassenbahn' appear at the top, and there is German text along the left edge.
